feat(camellia): refine shadcn style shell

Summary:
- add an explicit camellia style registry instead of hard-coded style checks
- refresh shared scaffold surfaces used across page headers, sections,
  forms, and query toolbars
- tighten the login and console shell chrome around the shadcn-style
  presentation baseline

Rationale:
- DAM-48 requires a concrete visual style on top of the DAM-47 shell work
- keeping style definitions named and centralized leaves room for more
  presets later without rewriting theme state wiring

Tests:
- pnpm --dir bougainvillea run check:camellia
- pnpm --dir bougainvillea --filter @bougainvillea/camellia start
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3000/login
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3000/
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3000/playground
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3000/ai/template
- curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3000/login | rg -n
  "shadcn/ui|Current style|Authentication|Default app|Access hints"
- git diff --check
